correctness.rationale: The synchronous directed-cycle recurrence translates a binary support by one each round. Planar difference λ=1 gives unique singleton intersections of all distinct facets, ensuring the root-relative face pairs are genuine elementary free-face collapses in descending cardinality, compatibly with every cyclic rotation. The output has vertex orbit G and k−1 edge orbits, including unique unit-step orbit. Direct integral generators N and z_{x,d} have zero boundary, are independent by distinct chord coefficients and span every integral cycle by reduction to the unit circle, with shift acting trivially on N and regularly on each z orbit. The all-parameter proof covers all finite perfect cyclic difference sets. The standalone standard-library checker exhaustively verified the difference property, firing orbit, face-coface freeness, collapse, Betti ranks and integer cycle basis covariance at orders q=2,3,4,5 (7+52+231+806=1096 actual collapse pairs). A deliberately non-perfect interval support violates the unique-intersection premise; computations are corroboration, not infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Gaschütz implies the rational/complex character of the collapsed cyclic cover after recognition of its quotient, so the rational character is not treated as independently novel. The explicit avalanching model, translation-symmetric collapse, and integral basis are the additional assertions. General integer-cover results may yet subsume the last step; this is recorded as a risk.

value.rationale: The motivating recent avalanche theory classifies special directed-cycle firing supports but does not describe the naturally nonconsecutive Singer family; perfect difference sets are canonical maximal-uniqueness cyclic designs. The new equivariant elementary-collapse model exhibits an integral Hamiltonian generator and free regular summands and determines their explicit translated cycles, a structural invariant invisible to the previously known nonequivariant q-cubed Betti rank. The theorem treats every prime-power order and connects sandpile dynamics, Singer incidence geometry and cyclic equivariant homotopy with a fully reproducible integral basis. It neither presents the familiar q³ rank alone as novel nor relies on a minor numerical gain.
